title: Prototype a receipted local extension composition boundary for V4 P10.1
goal: Implement and validate a canonical-source synthetic prototype for the missing package-external Profile and module composition contract while preserving immutable released 1.1.0 and deferring version promotion, publication and IFX practice.
acceptanceCriteria: The gap in released 1.1.0 and the separate base-release versus composed-installation identities are recorded without editing the published installation.
The proposed local-only bundle, composition and external receipt contracts require deterministic output, schema/hash/capability checks and complete file inventories.
The selected H1-H4 receipt, bundle trust, capability and retirement choices and human-review authority xiaolong-feng are recorded; no real bundle approval is inferred from this planning decision.
The exact prototype source and test paths are declared and Formal Pre accepts this implementation checkpoint before source changes.
A synthetic-only bundle proves positive composition, negative refusal, determinism, receipt drift detection, root immutability and installed Host/UI consumption on Windows and network-disabled Linux.
Product version promotion, CI-approved test hash refresh, IFX Profile practice, parity, remote publication, workflow/ruleset mutation and cutover remain outside this prototype checkpoint.
